00:17:27	jochem-brouwer:	Antwoord verzenden naar "@jochem-brouwer , ..."

This is the spamoor attack: 

Deploys a JUMPDEST-contract caller that cycles through indices 4000..70678 only, then hits it with full-block zero-calldata txs that keeps loop-calling these contracts and saves where it ended up at, such that the next tx can pick that up. Targets contracts were created by spamoor ID 100. Signed off by Jochem.
